means: constructed from the shapes file by an enumerator and a solver; nobody played these boards; no claim id, no badge Per soft-drop budget, the set of k mirror pairs (learning a shape includes its mirror; a pair is the board and its mirror, one board when they coincide or the mirror is in neither artefact) maximising the number of (first-bag order, bag-2 deal, bag-3 deal) triples that build and get a bag-3 Perfect Clear when the best member of the union is picked for each first-bag order; exact over the boards counted in the two artefacts (the kept boards and the x boards); a board in neither is uncounted.

rules.pair: a candidate is {board, its mirror} (one board when they coincide or the mirror is in neither artefact); k counts pairs and a set is the union of their boards
rules.pick: over the boards of the union, larger (J, built), ties to the earlier board position; none when no board builds within the budget
rules.set: larger pc3, then larger built, then the smaller tuple of pair positions (a pair sits at its smaller board position)
rules.dominance: u is dropped when v has key >= key_u on every order (key = J*8192+built, 0 when unavailable) and the keys differ somewhere or v is earlier; the dominator recorded is the earliest non-dominated one
rules.exact: k = 1, 2 by scan, k = 3 by branch and bound on f(abc) <= f(ab) + min(f(ac) - f(a), f(bc) - f(b)) over pc3
rules.greedy: best (pc3, built) added each step, ties to the smaller position; from_exact3 extends the exact triple
rules.tree: optimal depth <= d over the 28 features, leaf = member maximising the leaf's (sum J, sum built)

tsd.means: the same search with J counted over the (first-bag order, bag-2 deal, bag-3 deal) triples whose bag-3 Perfect Clear plan contains a full T-spin Double (analysis/tst-openers-tp-tsd.json); inside this block the field named pc3 is that count. Only bag-3 Perfect Clears are counted, bag 4 is not.
